<function name="GravGunPunt" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>
Called when an entity is about to be punted with the gravity gun (primary fire).

By default this function makes <page>ENTITY:GravGunPunt</page> work in Sandbox derived gamemodes.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<file line="7-L9">gamemodes/base/gamemode/gravitygun.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player wielding the gravity gun</arg>
		<arg name="ent" type="Entity">The entity the player is attempting to punt</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to allow and false to disallow.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
